comment: Canonical machine-path ban set for the public docs gates. scripts/check-docs.mjs and scripts/release-check.ps1 both read this file, so a durable doc cannot pass one gate and fail the other on the same path. Entries are regular-expression source text shared by the JavaScript and .NET engines; Select-String and RegExp are case-insensitive on these. The first ban carries the one documented engine-default allowance: the llama.cpp install default under C:\Inference stays legal, and nothing else under that root is.
